notes.title: Lefties & Map 1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed bug where left handed users could get locked out of the menu (sorry!). 
Also fixed bug where stars for Map 1 did not show. 
Let us know of any other bugs on our Discord!

notes.title: Pre-Slurpies FREE Hot Patch
notes.notes:
In this quick patch before the release of Slurpies FREE on Friday, we made a couple of tweaks:

[list]
[*] Pause menu now appears in center of arena each time
[*] Layering fixes for more readable UI
[*] Further decreased loading time
[*] Multiplayer fix for virus movement
[*] Fixed lighting and shadows on Crystal Cave
[*] Fixed the blending colors of edibles on Mixie Mixup
[*] Simplified font style in boss battle for accessibility
[/list]

notes.title: Zen Patch Update
notes.notes:
You asked and we listened! We could not be more excited to deliver the all new Zen Patch to Space Slurpies.

[previewyoutube=yrrPQsYKfE0;full][/previewyoutube]

This patch attempts to deliver everything that fans of Space Slurpies has been asking for. This patch is so big that no amount of scribbled notes could cover it all, but here are some of the highlights:
[list]
[*] [b]Zen Mode[/b] - The all new Zen Mode is a unique way to enjoy slurpin' action. Instead of fighting against enemies, you're trying to beat the clock while relaxing in the many vibrant environments by collecting rings. Chill out dude, it's Zen Mode!
[*] [b]9 New Maps[/b] - With the Zen Patch comes 8 new Zen-themed maps. Inspired by the most relaxing environments in nature, we take up the chill factor in Slurpies 10 levels. There's a map inspired by each of the four seasons and all are filled with the newest baddie - the Zen Rock. 
[*] [b]Modifiers[/b] - With the new modifiers, you can customize any game with hundreds of combinations. We're introducing Double Slurp Mode (yes, a Slurpie in each hand!), Big Head Mode, Slug Mode (they get fatter as they eat instead of just longer lol), Never Die Mode (perfect for chilling with your friends online), and more! 
[*] [b]Boss Mode[/b] - Space Slurpies first boss shows up in the universe! On Raging Robots, users battle a giant robot by trying to combine their scores and blow it up. Find three friends and see if you can beat him!
[*] [b]Ninja Slurp[/b] - Only the truly zen can unlock and play as the all new Ninja Slurp skin. Best of luck great warrior!
[*] [b]Region Selector[/b] - Play with friends anywhere in the world with the new region selector for private matches.
[*] [b]Bug fixes[/b] - Yeah, we fixed everything we knew about. If I wrote them all down, would you really read them? I doubt it. I'm going back to coding now...
[/list]
